## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-6001. The issue was that the 4.8.0 release added a `log-forwarder` sidecar container without resource requests. Kubernetes requires all containers in a pod to have resource requests defined for the HPA to calculate CPU metrics. The missing resource requests on the sidecar caused the HPA to show "cpu <unknown>" and stop scaling. I provided two fix options: adding resource requests to the sidecar (recommended) or switching the HPA to track only the main container using ContainerResource metrics.
